title: Bugtraq is back
summary: Bugtraq, one of the most influential and historic computer security mailing lists that had been discontinued for years, has returned to SecurityFocus. The list was originally a primary venue for vulnerability disclosure and security discussions in the early 2000s before its discontinuation.
problem_solved: Marks the revival of a historic security mailing list that served as a crucial platform for vulnerability disclosure and security research community collaboration for over a decade.
why_valuable: Restores access to a legendary security resource that shaped the vulnerability disclosure process and fostered the security research community, providing a familiar platform for continued security discussions.
